test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: When Bank Reconciliation Statement is started with favourable balance as per cash book, which of the following will be added?

options.text: Direct payment by customer in Pass Book only.
Under - casting of credit side of the Pass Book.
Cheques deposited in Bank, but not cleared.
Amount withdrawn from Bank not recorded in the Cash Book.

solution:
The correct answer is **Direct payment by customer in Pass Book only.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Direct payment by customer in Pass Book only:**

 
 
• When a customer makes a direct payment into the bank account, it gets recorded in the Pass Book immediately.
 
• However, if the Cash Book is not updated simultaneously, this amount will not appear in the Cash Book yet.
 
• To reconcile the balances, this amount must be added to the Cash Book balance to match the Pass Book balance.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Under - casting of credit side of the Pass Book:**

 
 
• This option is incorrect. Under-casting means that the total of the credit side is understated. This would require adjustment in the Pass Book, not in the Cash Book.
 
 
 
• **Cheques deposited in Bank, but not cleared:**
 
 
• This option is incorrect. Cheques not cleared means they are recorded in the Cash Book but not yet in the Pass Book. This would need a deduction, not an addition.
 
 
 
• **Amount withdrawn from Bank not recorded in the Cash Book:**
 
 
• This option is incorrect. If an amount is withdrawn from the bank and not recorded in the Cash Book, it would actually decrease the bank balance, requiring a deduction rather than an addition.
